svg.title: A Christmas celebration shaped by care

text.tspan: Gifts and decorations mark a Christmas gathering.
A Christmas celebration shaped by care
When we prepare a Christmas gathering, a little care can make the experience better. Planning
and thinking about other people both help.
First, a modest plan protects time for people rather than purchases. For example, we agree on a
small gift budget and reuse wrapping materials. This is a small thing that makes the day easier.
Second, asking about traditions helps guests feel respected. For example, we explain our own
customs while leaving room for guests to take part differently. We do not need a perfect day to do
We can prepare a Christmas gathering more easily when we prepare and notice other people.
These simple steps give us a useful place to start.
BUILD YOUR OWN · State a clear main idea; develop two different points with examples; bring them together in the
conclusion. Each body paragraph needs a distinct point and a concrete example. The conclusion should connect the
argument rather than introduce a new proposal.
